### Identity and scope
Package/version and source, equipment model, firmware, OS and BLE stack versions:

### Evidence category
Passive observation, offline replay, simulation, or separately authorized controls?
Do not perform new live actions simply to complete this template.

### Observations
Characteristics, explicit format choices, expected/actual values, diagnostics,
and minimal sanitized bytes. Explain unavailable firmware/version evidence.

### Limits and reproducibility
What was not tested? Were commands sent? Were results repeatable across connections?

Remove device addresses, serial numbers, personal activity data and credentials.
Do not attach raw captures without reviewing them. A report does not establish
universal interoperability, physical accuracy, safe controls, PTS or qualification.
